adaptations: local.go foreground Run lifecycle and Resolve shape reused; remove sandbox, background, managed env, persistent/PowerShell/coreutils/spill paths.
Output collector extracts source tailWriter.Write/Output algorithm without spill/observer state.
types.go retains foreground request/spec/result/interface shapes only.
Unix configureProcess/processSignal adapted; cancellation always forces group kill after grace even when leader exits, plus normal-completion descendant cleanup.
Add explicit executable/workspace validation, environment allowlist with no inheritance, hard limits, WaitDelay and unsupported-platform fail closed.
Run revalidates direct ExecSpec input, returns timeout/cancellation errors with populated result flags; nonzero exit remains a result.
All tests are new regressions using temporary workspace and bounded local processes.

Store workspace os.FileInfo and require Lstat/SameFile identity at Resolve and immediately before process.Start; reject root replacement/symlink and regression-test pre-resolved commands. Pathname race protection is not claimed as sandboxing.

Optional strict confinement is reintroduced through the standalone sandbox package; CheckConfinement validates root and backend before approval and execution. No fallback when strict mode is requested.

Windows PowerShell startup is composed explicitly only through the Windows ACL sandbox backend, using fixed noninteractive arguments, cooperative stdin-EOF Job Object cancellation and a bounded forced-cleanup warning. Unsandboxed Windows remains refused; result metadata preserves partial read/network non-isolation.

New terminal*.go PTY implementation reuses the existing executor workspace/environment/process-group contract; no reference implementation or third-party prompt/test source was copied. Native composition owns live handles and durable intents.
